column1: # Shared corpus for the handwritten validators (is_valid_commodity,
# is_valid_account, parse_amount) and the grammar entry points
# (commodityInput / accountInput / amountInput in Ledger.g4 and Prices.g4).
# Every row must get the same verdict from the validator and from every
# entry point that defines the kind; src/ledger_parser/grammar_parity.rs
# Columns: kind<TAB>valid|invalid<TAB>input. The input is taken verbatim,
# or decoded as a JSON string when it starts with a double quote (for inputs
# that are empty or carry leading or trailing blanks, which editors strip).
# '#' lines and empty lines are ignored.
# A name cannot contain a date-shaped piece: wherever the lexer would start
# a token, YYYY-MM-DD is a DATETIME, which is neither a commodity nor an
# account piece. Inside a longer alphanumeric or decimal run it is not a
# token boundary, so a_2026-01-15 and 2026.2026-01-15 are fine.
